selected.primary_estimand: Contractile-activity-specific transcriptome response: exercised (Ex) vs contralateral non-exercised (NE) vastus lateralis at +1 h and +4 h after 60-min one-legged knee extension, within subject, in untrained and (after 2 mo aerobic training) trained state; secondary: training effect on baseline transcriptome (trained vs untrained baseline).
planned_contrasts: Ex vs NE at +1 h, untrained (abstract: 'DEGs between exercised and nonexercised muscle were evaluated at 1 and 4 h'; no count in abstract)
Ex vs NE at +4 h, untrained (same locator; no count in abstract)
Ex vs NE at +1 h, trained (GEO summary: 'in both untrained and trained skeletal muscle'; no count)
Ex vs NE at +4 h, trained (same; no count)
trained vs untrained at baseline (abstract: 'Transcriptome change at baseline after 2 mo of aerobic training'; no count)
selected.inclusion: 7 untrained males, 84 samples = 7 subjects x 2 training states x 3 times x 2 legs (GEO overall design)
selected.repeated_measure_unit: subject (all 12 conditions from each of 7 men)
selected.normalization: DESeq normalization of HTSeq counts (GEO data_processing)
selected.paper_method: DESeq family (GEO data_processing: HTSeq counts, 'Normalization of read counts provided by DESeq method'); exact DE model, pairing and threshold not stated in abstract

paper_threshold.source_locator: not in abstract; full text unavailable

selected.paper_results: Abstract only: contractile-activity-specific responses were increases only (no decreased genes), regulated by CREB/ATF/AP1, MYC/MAX, E2F TFs; training-induced baseline changes (up and down) were more pronounced than acute contractile-specific responses and involved IRF/STAT TFs. GEO summary: contractile-specific responses in trained muscle substantially decreased relative to untrained.

decisions.reason: Full text not available; reconstruction rests on the PubMed abstract (PMID 30779632) and GEO series description only. Factors and sample structure from GEO overall design and sample characteristics.

checks: GEO series GSE120862 lists PMID 30779632 (Series_pubmed_id) and has the paper's title

GEO supplementary files (DESeq-normalized counts, FPKM) returned HTTP 403 from GEO FTP and the GEO download endpoint on 2026-11-24; matrix taken instead from recount3 uniform processing of SRA project SRP163524, which GEO links (Series_relation SRA)
recount3 metadata maps 84 SRR runs one-to-one to the 84 GSM accessions (experiment_attributes 'GEO Accession'); sample titles match GEO titles

decisions.reason: The data are the paper's own 84 libraries, reprocessed by recount3 (STAR/GENCODE v26) rather than the authors' HISAT2/HTSeq pipeline. Recorded as a matrix-source deviation.
Matrix columns are GSM ids (renamed from SRR in prep via recount3 metadata); exact match on metadata index. Factors tr (U/T), time (b/h1/h4), leg (NE/Ex), plus subject.

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

decisions.reason: recount3 gene_sums are per-base coverage sums; prep divided by single-end read length (SRA read_info) and rounded, as recount3::compute_read_counts does. Integer fraction 1.0 after rounding. Paper input was HTSeq raw counts (GEO data_processing); the deposited GEO files (DESeq-normalized counts, FPKM) were unreachable.

selected.analysis_type: factorial repeated measures (training x time x leg, all within subject)

decisions.reason: Paper's contractile-specific estimand is Ex vs NE leg at the same time point within subject (abstract). Training effect at baseline is trained vs untrained baseline; the abstract does not say whether legs were pooled, so it is run per leg (NE leg is the cleaner baseline: the Ex leg's baseline biopsy is 48 h after the prior bout). All from one model on 84 samples with subject blocking. Rejected: separate factors with interaction (paper describes cell-wise comparisons); pooling legs at baseline (unknown, would double-count subjects without a leg term).

covariates.name: subject
covariates.disposition: blocking term (repeated measures, all 12 cells per subject)

covariates.disposition: not added: nested in subject (S1-S4 HiSeq 2500, S5-S7 NextSeq 500), absorbed by subject block

decisions.reason: Every subject contributes every cell, so contrasts are within-subject. Sequencing platform is constant within subject, so the subject term absorbs it and it is balanced across all contrasts.

subject-blocked DESeq2 model; paper's pairing not confirmed from abstract

decisions.reason: Estimated counts rounded in prep (documented) -> DESeq2 with subject blocking, the closest validated route to the authors' DESeq normalisation.

selected.deviation_note: Paper threshold not available (abstract only). Applied BH padj<0.05, no fold-change rule. Audit adds |FC|>1.2 (log2 0.2630344) as a labelled comparison rule only.

decisions.reason: No threshold in abstract or GEO description; workflow default.

One DESeq2 model on all 84 samples (~ subject + tr*time*leg). Planned: 4 Ex-vs-NE + 2 training-baseline. Exploratory: baseline Ex vs NE (leg-difference check) and time-within-leg changes (abstract: post-exercise changes in exercised muscle include circadian effects, which the NE leg also shows).
